elena (prod): Heads-up: planning sync — enterprise compliance roadmap. Primary asks: audit log retention tiers & export SLA, BYOK/KMS onboarding cadence, SOC2 evidence packaging. Need a prioritized list for PM review by EOD Wed. @tom @jack

 tom (security): Noted. For audit logs, customers are coalescing around 90d searchable + 7y cold export. Major lift is export tooling + query-in-archive. Suggest 2-phase: MVP = 90d searchable + S3 export; Phase 2 = cold query + indexed archival.

 prateek (infra): Agree with phases. BYOK note: non-HSM handshake (customer-provided key material) + managed-wrapping is fastest. HSM-backed escrow/rotation is ~3-sprint dependency (ops + cert). Rough estimates: MVP 2 sprints for handshake + telemetry, HSM GA in 4 sprints.

 maria (sales): FWIW customers keep asking for 1y searchable as the minimum. We can upsell an "audit premium" for >90d. Also they want contractual language for immutable audit streams and handoff receipts.

 elena (prod): Can someone map effort => customer impact quickly so we can prioritize?

 tom (security): Quick matrix below — coarse but useful:

 ```text
 RetentionTier | Searchable | Export  | Effort
 ------------- | ---------- | ------- | -----
 90d           | yes        | basic   | M
 1y            | yes        | full    | L
 7y cold       | no         | archive | XL
 ```

 jack (legal): Legal: SOC2 requires chain-of-custody and a clear evidence-handback process. For BYOK we need a key escrow/escrow-exception policy and sample contract clause before any pilot commitments.

 prateek (infra): Ops caveat: export jobs will need autoscale and careful batching. Expected infra cost bump ~+8-12% during heavy exports depending on retention tier. We'll model in the PRD.

 elena (prod): Decision question: do we gate GA on BYOK/HSM? Proposal: BYOK support available in GA but HSM-backed BYOK is an "enterprise tier" GA feature — pilot available to early adopters with non-HSM flow.

 maria (sales): @elena That covers most accounts, but BigBank will push for HSM day-1. We should prepare a mitigation (SLA credit or pilot concession).

 tom (security): Mitigation option: offer an "interop pack" for BigBank — runbook + monthly attestation + fallback to Redwood-managed KMS for emergency. Also document fallback routing in the SLA.

 compliance-bot: Reminder: SOC2 gap doc updated — https://redwood.internal/soc2-gaps (new checklist v2).

 elena (prod): Action items: (1) PRD draft with prioritized list (elena) due Tue EOD, (2) security runbook (tom) due Wed, (3) legal sample clause (jack) due Thu, (4) infra cost appendix (prateek) due Wed. Any objections?

 jack (legal): No objections. I'll draft a short contract snippet focused on chain-of-custody + BYOK escrow clause.

 maria (sales): I'll compile list of accounts with hard BYOK/HSM asks and share a sales appendix.

 prateek (infra): I'll start ticketing infra work and include rollout gating + autoscale cost model.

 elena (prod): Quick poll — thumbs if ok with BYOK enterprise-gate approach :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

 sam (eng): :thumbsup:

 maria (sales): :thumbsup:

 tom (security): :thumbsup:

 jack (legal): :thumbsup:

 elena (prod): Thanks all — closing this thread. I will file the PRD stub and link back. If anything changes ping me directly.
